qualification: Package and project-hook contracts only; not a Cursor Cloud Agent execution
sourceConflict: The canonical hooks and Cloud help pages include beforeSubmitPrompt/afterAgentResponse/stop. The third-party-hooks page still says these are unavailable. Verify actual hosted delivery and ordering before enabling the adapter.
setupLocation: The repository root inside the selected Cloud environment, not the developer's local IDE
credentials: Injected runtime environment only; do not read, persist or copy local credential profiles into the repository or image
privacyApproval: Secret-free project-bound 0600 settings outside the repository preserve --no-capture-content on repeated setup and prevent repository-only privacy escalation
ownerActions: Use an eligible Cursor Cloud account and authorize the repository/environment
Add environment-scoped dashboard secrets and restart any already running agent
Install the maintained distribution in the Cloud environment and include it in a successful Build
Review and deploy the generated nonsecret project config and repository hooks; setup never commits, pushes, enrolls accounts or grants trust
Run an authorized real Cloud task, verify observed event payloads and Future AGI ingestion/readback, and capture real trace media

traceContract.unit: One observed turn when beforeSubmitPrompt exists, otherwise a source-generation-anchored incomplete run
traceContract.tools: Generic preToolUse/postToolUse/postToolUseFailure only, avoiding duplicate shell/file hook families
traceContract.subagents: Nested only with exact parent_tool_use_id plus subagent_id
traceContract.modelRequests: Unavailable; do not manufacture LLM requests from prompts or final responses
traceContract.transcripts: Never read on this unqualified hosted surface
gaps: PROMPT_NOT_OBSERVED when the prompt hook is absent
traceContract.mcp: Omit output when Cloud supplies redacted:true; do not claim full HTTP MCP tool results

safety.content: On by default; FI_AGENT_CAPTURE_CONTENT=false or setup --no-capture-content; known FI-key redaction and 20000-character field cap
safety.state: Bounded, encrypted, owner-only state outside the repository; separate Cloud namespace
safety.killSwitch: FI_AGENT_ENABLED=false and shared lifecycle disable fence both collection and export
safety.failOpen: No stdout or permission decisions; exit 1 (not 0/2) for the documented Cursor fail-open protocol
safety.deadline: Nonterminal 220ms process deadline; terminal 6s process deadline, 7s host hook timeout
safety.delivery: One terminal export attempt with finalized local tombstone; ambiguous delivery can lose a trace, no exactly-once guarantee

publicationGates: Real hosted execution and event matrix qualification
Eligible account, authorized repository and dashboard environment/secrets
Public package installation and release owner approval
Real Future AGI readback and sanitized screenshot/GIF for the new docs page
docs: Do not publish a customer quick start for an unavailable package or use local IDE/CLI media as evidence for Cursor Cloud. The docs site supports real PNG/WebP/GIF/video assets without a framework change.
